stroke-counts.json is derived from the kTotalStrokes field of the Unicode Unihan Database
(https://www.unicode.org/Public/UCD/latest/ucd/Unihan.zip), rebuilt with scripts/build-stroke-counts.py.

scripts/font-common-chars.txt, the character list of the on-demand font extension (maanshan/font-slices.mjs
and maanshan/vendor/fonts/noto-*-hk-ext-NN.woff2), is derived from the kBigFive, kHKGlyph, kGradeLevel,
kGB0, kHanyuPinlu and kSimplifiedVariant fields of the same database, rebuilt with
scripts/build-font-common-chars.py.
